carrier_registration_token_check.name: carrier_registration_token_check
carrier_registration_token_check.value: "carrier_registration"."status" <> 'pending_email' or ("carrier_registration"."token_hash" is not null and "carrier_registration"."expires_at" is not null)

booking_dock_check.name: booking_dock_check
booking_dock_check.value: "booking"."dock_id" is not null or "booking"."status" not in ('called', 'at_dock', 'loading')

invitation_role_check.name: invitation_role_check
invitation_role_check.value: ("invitation"."org_kind" = 'platform' and "invitation"."role" in ('platform_admin')) or ("invitation"."org_kind" = 'tenant' and "invitation"."role" in ('tenant_admin', 'dispatcher', 'gate_operator', 'dock_operator')) or ("invitation"."org_kind" = 'carrier' and "invitation"."role" in ('carrier_admin', 'carrier_user'))

membership_role_check.name: membership_role_check
membership_role_check.value: ("membership"."org_kind" = 'platform' and "membership"."role" in ('platform_admin')) or ("membership"."org_kind" = 'tenant' and "membership"."role" in ('tenant_admin', 'dispatcher', 'gate_operator', 'dock_operator')) or ("membership"."org_kind" = 'carrier' and "membership"."role" in ('carrier_admin', 'carrier_user'))

user_select.name: user_select
user_select.using: ((select app.party()) = 'user') and (exists (select 1 from membership m where m.org_id = "org"."id" and m.user_id = (select app.user_id())))

tenant_select.name: tenant_select
tenant_select.using: ((select app.party()) = 'tenant') and ("org"."id" = (select app.tenant_id()) or exists (select 1 from tenant_carrier_link l where l.tenant_id = (select app.tenant_id()) and l.carrier_id = "org"."id") or exists (select 1 from carrier_registration r where r.tenant_id = (select app.tenant_id()) and r.carrier_id = "org"."id"))

carrier_select.name: carrier_select
carrier_select.using: ((select app.party()) = 'carrier') and ("org"."id" = (select app.carrier_id()) or app.linked_tenant("org"."id") or exists (select 1 from carrier_registration r where r.carrier_id = (select app.carrier_id()) and r.tenant_id = "org"."id"))

any_select_platform_rows.name: any_select_platform_rows
any_select_platform_rows.using: (select app.party()) is not null and "setting_value"."tenant_id" is null

tenant_all.name: tenant_all
tenant_all.using: ((select app.party()) = 'tenant') and (("setting_value"."tenant_id" = (select app.tenant_id())) and ("setting_value"."site_id" is null or app.site_allowed("setting_value"."site_id")))
tenant_all.withCheck: ((select app.party()) = 'tenant') and (("setting_value"."tenant_id" = (select app.tenant_id())) and ("setting_value"."site_id" is null or app.site_allowed("setting_value"."site_id")))

setting_value_site_needs_tenant.name: setting_value_site_needs_tenant
setting_value_site_needs_tenant.value: "setting_value"."site_id" is null or "setting_value"."tenant_id" is not null

any_insert.name: any_insert
any_insert.withCheck: (select app.party()) is not null and ("outbox_message"."tenant_id" is null or "outbox_message"."tenant_id" = (select app.tenant_id()))

driver_select.name: driver_select
driver_select.using: ((select app.party()) = 'driver') and (("safety_content"."tenant_id" = (select app.tenant_id())) and (exists (select 1 from safety_version v where v.id = "safety_content"."version_id" and v.status = 'published')))
